title: Online Environment Repair for Coding Agents
title_zh: 面向代码智能体的在线环境修复
abstract_en: Programmatic verifiers provide scalable reward signals for training coding agents with reinforcement learning, yet subtle harness defects and incomplete unit tests allow policies to earn full credit without solving the intended task. Existing training-time defenses intervene either by penalizing suspicious outputs or by filtering flagged tasks and rollouts. However, output penalties leave the underlying verifier exploitable, driving policies to disguise shortcuts under reasoning monitors or zeroing out valid solutions under detector false positives, whereas task and rollout filtering discards or mutes the hardest problems where shortcuts emerge earliest. Pre-training verifier hardening repairs the environment directly, but misses vulnerability classes that surface only as the policy improves during reinforcement learning. In this paper, we propose online environment repair, which leaves triggering rollout rewards unchanged to remove hiding incentives and asynchronously patches exploited environments during training. Candidate repairs triggered by execution invariants or differential fuzzing are deployed only after passing three automated validation gates that block the exploit while preserving valid solutions, canceling detector false positives and enabling structural propagation across repositories without scaffold labels or reference solutions. Across 20 controlled GRPO experiments on heterogeneous software-engineering repositories, online environment repair reduces cumulative reward hacking from 36.9% to 0.06% and improves held-out Pass@8 from 21.7% to 46.7%, consistently outperforming reward-penalty, rollout-filtering, and static-hardening baselines while eliminating zero-shot exploitation on unseen loophole classes.
abstract_zh: 程序化验证器能为代码智能体的强化学习训练提供可扩展的奖励信号，但评测框架的缺陷与单元测试覆盖不足，可能让策略在未完成目标任务时获得满分。对可疑输出施加惩罚无法修复验证器本身，还可能促使策略隐藏取巧行为，或因检测误报而误罚正确解；过滤任务或采样轨迹（rollout）则会削弱最难任务提供的学习信号。训练前的静态加固也难以发现只有在策略变强后才暴露的漏洞。本文提出在线环境修复（Online Environment Repair）：保留触发修复的轨迹奖励不变，以消除隐藏取巧行为的激励，同时在训练期间异步修复被利用的评测环境。由执行不变量或差分模糊测试触发的候选修复，只有通过三道自动验证关卡才会部署，以确认修复既能封堵漏洞，又能保留有效解。这一流程能够排除检测误报，并在不依赖评测脚手架标签或参考解的情况下，将修复推广至结构相似的代码仓库。在涵盖多种软件工程仓库的 20 组受控 GRPO 实验中，该方法将累计奖励投机率从 36.9% 降至 0.06%，将留出集 Pass@8 从 21.7% 提升至 46.7%，持续优于奖励惩罚、轨迹过滤和静态加固基线，并在实验中消除了对未见漏洞类别的零样本利用。
key_points_zh: 保留触发轨迹的原始奖励，异步修复验证器；不靠惩罚策略或丢弃困难任务来抑制奖励投机。
候选修复须通过三道自动验证关卡，确认既封堵漏洞，又不影响有效解。
修复可推广至结构相似的代码仓库，无需评测脚手架标签或参考解。
20 组受控 GRPO 实验中，累计奖励投机率从 36.9% 降至 0.06%，留出集 Pass@8 从 21.7% 升至 46.7%。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 核心贡献是利用编码智能体的训练反馈在线修复验证器：保留触发修复的轨迹奖励，验证后异步部署补丁。20 项受控实验报告了奖励投机下降和留出任务表现提升，支持采用在线修复，而非仅惩罚输出、过滤轨迹或预先加固。
